get.summary: Deletes a playlist folder, releasing its contents.
get.description: OpenSubsonic extension name `playlistFolders` (as returned by `getOpenSubsonicExtensions`). Deletes a folder from the authenticated user's playlist organization. If the folder is not empty, child folders are re-parented to the deleted folder's parent. Playlists with no remaining folder placements appear at the root.

parameters.name: playlistFolderId
parameters.description: ID of the playlist folder to delete.

post.summary: Deletes a playlist folder, releasing its contents.
post.description:
OpenSubsonic extension name `playlistFolders` (as returned by `getOpenSubsonicExtensions`). Deletes a folder from the authenticated user's playlist organization. If the folder is not empty, child folders are re-parented to the deleted folder's parent. Playlists with no remaining folder placements appear at the root.

Requires OpenSubsonic extension name `formPost` (as returned by `getOpenSubsonicExtensions`).

playlistFolderId.description: ID of the playlist folder to delete.
